rec: 2022 congressional plan 'Ad Astra 2' (Substitute for Senate Bill 355)
Kansas Legislature, Sub. for SB 355 ('Ad Astra 2'): veto overridden by the Senate Feb. 8 and the House Feb. 9, 2022; 'Enrolled - Law effective February 10, 2022'

The Governor vetoed it Feb. 3, 2022; the Senate overrode Feb. 8 and the House Feb. 9 (law effective Feb. 10). A Wyandotte County district judge found it unconstitutional, but the Kansas Supreme Court reversed in May 2022 (full opinions June 21, 2022) and it was used in 2022 and 2024. Four districts. Census check: cb_2022_us_cd118 (CDSESSN 118; lines supplied by the states by Aug. 31, 2022) holds this plan; 0 of 4 districts differ in shape from the 2024 file.

rec: 2022 state Senate plan 'Liberty 3' (Substitute for Senate Bill 563): 40 districts

Kansas Legislature, Sub. for SB 563 (state senatorial plan 'Liberty 3', state representative plan 'Free State 3F', state board of education plan 'Apple 7'): approved by the Governor April 15, 2022; law effective April 21, 2022

Approved by the Governor Apr. 15, 2022 (law effective Apr. 21); the Kansas Supreme Court upheld it in May 2022. No Senate election was held in 2022 (Kansas elects its Senate in presidential years), so these lines were first voted on in 2024. Census check: cb_2022_us_sldu (LSY 2022, 40 districts; boundaries collected for the 2022 election year, file made April 2023); 0 of 40 districts differ in shape from the 2024 file.
